## Open

### T-127 — Implement the planned adapter idle handling

> _2026-09-22 · core/blong-gogo · open_

Planned feature, not a defect (reworded from S20 at the maintainer request: keep the names, present
them as future work). patterns/handler.md documents idleSend, idleReceive and drainSend as the
intended lifecycle hooks for keep-alive and idle handling, and the page now marks them as planned
rather than current while saying which configuration is already written for them. To implement:
dispatch the three hooks from the adapter loop (idle after a configured quiet period on the send and
the receive side, drain when the send queue empties), read the idleSend and idleReceive
configuration keys that concepts/adapter.md:35, patterns/adapter.md and
test/framework/ctp/adapter/payshield.ts:10 already set, and give AdapterBase.drain, which is
subscribed to the drain event, real behaviour.

### T-142 — blong-gogo graceful shutdown test fails on its own

> _2026-09-24 · core/blong-gogo · open_

src/graceful-shutdown.spawn.test.ts fails with the CLI exiting 143 rather than 0, both in a full run
and when run alone, while the rest of the suite is green. Nothing in this session touched the CLI or
its shutdown path, so it looks pre-existing and environment-dependent: check whether the marker file
is flushed before the signal is delivered, and whether a loaded machine is enough to lose the race,
before changing the code.

### T-153 — Teach the browser guards about modules the loader imports dynamically

> _2026-09-26 · core/blong-gogo · open_

core/blong-gogo/scripts/browser-compat-check.mjs (node --run browser-check) is the only check that
catches a module a dev server cannot link, since it starts a dev server, opens Chromium and fails on
any console error, but nothing runs it and it needs Chromium. Wire it into CI for one suite, or
extend core/blong-browser/src/browserBundle.test.ts with a development-mode build so the modules the
loader imports dynamically become part of the graph it inspects — a static import inside one of them
breaks the page in dev while a production bundle stays silent. The source scan in
core/blong-gogo/src/browserEagerImports.test.ts covers the chain only; other node-only modules
belong in its NODE_ONLY list once they are known.

### T-154 — The slow-step margin does not reach the registry's start steps

> _2026-09-26 · core/blong-gogo · open_

`log.slowMs` tunes the loader's steps and the retention store, and a runner may raise it for a
machine that is legitimately slow, but two callers of `withProgress` ignore it. `Registry.ts` passes
`getProgress` only for `create ports`, `start ports`, `ready ports` and `stop ports`, and
`core/blong-gogo/src/adapter/server/knex.ts`'s `ready` does the same for `schema table sync` and the
constraint pass, so all of them keep the compiled default of 1000ms and raising the margin cannot
silence them. If a slow startup ever warns under one of those labels, this is why. Give those calls
the configured margin — check first what the registry's `#config` carries, since the `log` block is
a platform-level sibling rather than part of the registry's section, while the knex adapter has the
same reach to `this.config`.
